svg.title: Plain Bob Minor - the work of one lead

g.text: A method is not a tune. It is a path through a grid.
Every bell moves one place a row, or stays. It cannot jump.
Nobody reads the numbers while ringing - they ring the line.
The numbers are the proof that the line is right.
This is one lead of Plain Bob Minor; five leads come back to rounds.
the order the six bells strike, once each
every bell moves one place, or stays
two places at once - a bell cannot jump
a path through a grid, not a tune
out to the back and in to the front
the line - the shape is memorised
are the proof that the line is right
carries both, on the same grid
